scope: quick primary-source verification; mechanisms and transfer limits
bibliographic_fallback: S2-API-UNAVAILABLE: Semantic Scholar/DOI attempts returned Internal Error; used primary arXiv full text, conference page and author repository where available

sources.title: SpecDec++: Boosting Speculative Decoding via Adaptive Candidate Lengths
sources.mechanism: Conditional acceptance prediction, cumulative rejection risk, stopping draft generation and calling target verification
sources.transfer_limit: Theorem 4.3 is a sufficient condition containing a problem-specific Delta; not a theorem for stopping repair while retaining raw suffix proposals
sources.evidence_type: primary theoretical and controlled computational study

sources.title: BERT Loses Patience: Fast and Robust Inference with Early Exit
sources.mechanism: Patience across layers for the same input; reset on changed prediction; regression uses a numerical difference threshold
sources.transfer_limit: Different token positions are not repeated predictions of the same label; patience over tail utility is a new hypothesis

sources.title: Learn then Test: Calibrating Predictive Algorithms to Achieve Risk Control
sources.version: v5, 2022-09-29; journal venue not independently verified
sources.mechanism: Valid multiple testing on a fixed candidate family using independent identically distributed calibration units
sources.transfer_limit: Correlated blocks cannot count as independent prompts; no automatic per-block, TPS or distribution-shift guarantee

sources.title: Confident Adaptive Language Modeling
sources.mechanism: Calibrate local layer exit signals against global generation consistency constraints using LTT
sources.transfer_limit: Exits layers rather than repair suffixes; consistency risks are not native acceptance length
sources.evidence_type: primary theoretical and controlled computational study

sources.title: Faster Assisted Generation with Dynamic Speculation
sources.mechanism: Assistant softmax confidence controls draft stopping before target verification
sources.transfer_limit: Example threshold 0.4 is not a calibrated repair stopping threshold; benchmark hardware/concurrency not imported

proposed_inferences_not_source_results: Dual thresholds on estimated remaining repair utility
Two consecutive low-utility decisions plus two/four further repaired positions
Retain at least 95 percent of same-body repair acceptance gain as an empirical selection objective
conflicts_and_quality: Authors evaluate their own methods; no independent financial conflict verification. Theory and engineering documentation are not assigned a medical-trial evidence grade.
